prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Greenvale Metro: urban railway (peak/off-peak/engineering-hour; underground/surface); Communications-Based Train Control (CBTC): separation, movement authority (MA), regulation; degraded: restrictive platform states, explicit controller action to restore automatic departure. All safety parts log time-stamped events (state changes, command accept/reject, comms loss, protective actions). Actors: Line Traffic Controller (LTC: monitors Lantern; holding/skip-stop/turnback/run-through only if interlocking and CBTC agree; no vital intervention; produces Temporary Speed Restriction Notice; station holds via dispatch controls; verifies revised timetable; receives Route Release Exception List in incident triage; sees fault summaries only, no maintenance commands). Revenue Train Operator (sees MA/speed/location confidence; acknowledges to Atlas; repeats back Voice Dispatch Console instructions; reports cab indications, handling, passenger impacts via degraded-service reporting channel). Signal Maintenance Engineer, alias Maple (initiates remote sessions, read-only unless approved maintenance window; verifies track clearance before route restore). Cyber Security Officer (reviews certificates, privileged access logs, credentials/encryption, workstation access). Local station staff: validated CBTC state indications. Elements: Metro Operations Control System, alias Lantern (regulation, alarms; sends Crew Login Token Bundle to Atlas). Maintenance Diagnostic Server, alias Quarry: receives event streams via monitored interfaces that cannot alter MA; compares Brake Curve Checksum Log to baseline. North District Zone Controller, alias Marble; South District Zone Controller, alias Orchid: send MA to Atlas; overlap/flank; handover; log health, interfaces, fallback transitions. East Junction Interlocking, alias Falcon (Axle Counter Reset Request), West Junction Interlocking (Route Release Exception List to LTC): final vital authority; log route commands, point detection, locks. Platform Screen Door Controller sends Platform Door Status Snapshot. Atlas Onboard Controller, alias Kestrel: ATP, doors; modes initialization/protected manual/ATO/fallback/cutout; produces Brake Curve Checksum Log; stores fault codes, MA acceptance, propulsion cutbacks. Dual Channel Odometer: plausibility data retained. Train Radio Modem (logs bearer loss, retries) via Wayside Radio Access Network; Encryption Certificate Renewal Pack from Cryptographic Key Management Appliance. Saffron (alias, unstated). Safety Data Communication Network. Voice Dispatch Console. Service Timetable Server.

New part:
S167: Failure triage first establishes whether the condition is safety critical, service affecting, cyber security related, or a maintenance-only defect.
S168: Safety critical failures remain under traffic control coordination until the Line Traffic Controller confirms the operating restriction and a Signal Maintenance Engineer confirms the engineering status.
S169: The Maintenance Diagnostic Server preserves raw events, normalised event records, diagnostic session notes, and file integrity values for post-incident analysis.
S170: Configuration records include software build identifiers, parameter set identifiers, radio configuration versions, interlocking data versions, and approved change references.
S171: The Cryptographic Key Management Appliance maintains certificate and key status records used to verify whether communications faults could be related to authentication or expiry conditions.
S172: The Service Timetable Server and Passenger Information Gateway are checked when reported symptoms involve timetable-driven routing assumptions or passenger-facing messages rather than train control protection.
S173: The Voice Dispatch Console is included in the evidence scope when verbal instructions, emergency calls, or manual coordination affected the response to an event.
S174: After a reportable incident, retained evidence is frozen under maintenance control, copied to a protected repository, and released only through the agreed engineering investigation process.
S175: During degraded operation, Greenvale Metro keeps trains stationary or moving at controlled speed until separation assurance is restored.
S176: A degraded mode is declared by the Line Traffic Controller when automatic movement authority, train localization, point detection, platform interface, or radio continuity cannot be trusted.
S177: The Metro Operations Control System shall present the affected limits, the selected fallback mode, and any pending operator actions without obscuring safety alarms.
S178: The Atlas Onboard Controller transitions to restricted manual operation when valid movement authority is unavailable or when onboard location confidence falls below the configured threshold.
S179: The Revenue Train Operator remains responsible for speed control, stopping accuracy, door release discipline, and compliance with verbal movement limits during restricted manual operation.
S180: The Dual Channel Odometer shall cause the train location to be treated as uncertain when its channels disagree beyond the permitted tolerance.
S181: The Train Radio Modem shall report loss of safe data connectivity to the Atlas Onboard Controller and shall not mask intermittent communication failures from the cab display.
S182: A failure in the Wayside Radio Access Network is handled by reducing train throughput before any extension of manual working is considered.
S183: The North District Zone Controller applies the Temporary Speed Restriction Notice only after validating the affected track limits against its degraded-mode map.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
